Senior Design Manager, Growth Products

Lead a team of four product designers working on our growth and onboarding products, while representing design in a partner organization that is still learning to work with design.

Responsibilities:
- Manage, mentor, and develop four designers: 1:1s, growth plans, hiring as the team expands.
- Run design critique and raise craft quality across the growth pod.
- Evangelize design's role with our partnerships organization, which has historically shipped without design involvement; influence partner-team roadmaps to make room for design.
- Balance long-term product ownership on onboarding with rotating partner-team engagements each quarter.
- Contribute to and champion adoption of the design system among partner teams that do not yet use it.
- Stay hands-on in Figma for key flows roughly one day a week.

About you:
- You have managed small design teams and enjoy developing people, and you can also make the case for design to teams that need convincing.
- Comfortable splitting energy between deepening one product and winning over new internal audiences.

Remote within the US. Compensation $190,000-$215,000.
